q: I gave my back to those who struck me, and my cheeks to those who pulled out the beard; I did not hide my face from insult and spitting.
Then he took the twelve aside and said to them, “See, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written about the Son of Man by the prophets will be accomplished.
points.apply: Plan now how your family will take part in every service of the Great Week.

sub: The blind man by the road.
q: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, nor are your ways my ways, says the LORD.
Then he opened their minds to understand the scriptures,
points.apply: Read one Gospel account of the Passion slowly before Hosanna Sunday, asking for light.

concl: The Great Fast is the soul's training, and its goal is hope in the living God.
Jesus goes up to Jerusalem to suffer and to rise; let us ask for eyes to understand.
2027-03-11.resolve: Keep one daily exercise of prayer until Easter, and read the Passion before Hosanna Sunday.

intro: Theme: “Very truly, I tell you, before Abraham was, I am.”
Abraham's hospitality at Mamre, Caleb's wholehearted old age, the armour of light, and the eternal Son who is the I AM.

sub: Is anything too wonderful for the Lord?
q: Is anything too wonderful for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, in due season, and Sarah shall have a son.
Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by doing that some have entertained angels without knowing it.
points.apply: Invite someone lonely to your table before Easter.

points.h: Put on the Lord Jesus Christ
sub: The one debt we always owe.
q: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my whole being shall exult in my God; for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation, he has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
Instead, put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, to gratify its desires.
points.apply: Lay aside one work of darkness this week, and replace it with a work of love.

sub: Abraham saw my day and was glad.
q: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM.” He said further, “Thus you shall say to the Israelites, ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
Very truly, I tell you, before Abraham was, I am.
points.apply: Pray the Way of the Cross today, and at each station adore Jesus as true God.

concl: The God who visited Abraham is the Son who was before Abraham, and who comes to our table.
Welcome him in every guest, follow him wholeheartedly, and put him on like a garment of light.
2027-03-12.resolve: Pray the Way of the Cross today, and invite someone lonely to your home before Easter.

intro: Theme: “Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”
Love without which every gift is nothing, the patient and kind love of daily life, and the marriage that God joined from the beginning.

q: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can floods drown it. If one offered for love all the wealth of one's house, it would be utterly scorned.
If I speak in the tongues of mortals and of angels, but do not have love, I am a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
points.apply: Do one good work today simply out of love, expecting nothing in return.

q: Therefore a man leaves his father and his mother and clings to his wife, and they become one flesh.
Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.
points.apply: Pray tonight for your own marriage, or for a marriage you know that is struggling.

q: One thing I asked of the LORD, that will I seek after: to live in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to inquire in his temple.
For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then we will see face to face. Now I know only in part; then I will know fully, even as I have been fully known.
points.apply: Spend ten minutes before the Blessed Sacrament this week, asking to see the Lord's face more clearly.

concl: Without love we are nothing; with Christ's love a home becomes a sanctuary.
What God has joined, his grace can keep; and the love we practise now will see him face to face.
2027-03-13.resolve: Read 1 Corinthians 13:4–7 each evening this week with your own name, and pray for the marriages in your family.

intro: Theme: “I have come as light into the world, so that everyone who believes in me should not remain in the darkness.”
An apostle who lives by the faith of his people, and the Lord who cries aloud that he came to save and not to condemn.

sub: To see him is to see the Father.
q: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
I have come as light into the world, so that everyone who believes in me should not remain in the darkness.
points.apply: Bring one hidden thing into the light of confession before Hosanna Sunday.

sub: A word refused does not vanish.
The Father's command is eternal life.
q: No, the word is very near to you; it is in your mouth and in your heart for you to observe.
The one who rejects me and does not receive my word has a judge; on the last day the word that I have spoken will serve as judge,
points.apply: Choose one word of Jesus from this week's Gospels and live by it for a day.

sub: Faith that keeps a pastor alive.
q: Where you go, I will go; where you lodge, I will lodge; your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
And may the Lord make you increase and abound in love for one another and for all, just as we abound in love for you.
points.apply: Write or call one person whose faith has strengthened yours, and thank them.

concl: Christ came as light, not to condemn but to save; his word is very near to us.
Those who stand firm in the Lord give life to others; let love increase and abound among us.
2027-03-15.resolve: This week, pray each evening by name for someone far away, and step into the light of confession before Hosanna Sunday.

intro: Theme: “How often have I desired to gather your children together as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, and you were not willing!”
God who rescues the righteous, and the Lord who will not turn from Jerusalem, grieving over every heart that refuses to be gathered.

points.h: The Lord knows how to rescue
q: But he lingered; so the men seized him and his wife and his two daughters by the hand, the Lord being merciful to him, and they brought him out and left him outside the city.
then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trial, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment
points.apply: Name one habit around you that no longer troubles you, and ask God to awaken your conscience.

points.h: I must be on my way
sub: Today, tomorrow and the third day.
q: The Lord God helps me; therefore I have not been disgraced; therefore I have set my face like flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame;
Yet today, tomorrow, and the next day I must be on my way, because it is impossible for a prophet to be killed outside of Jerusalem.
points.apply: Do not let fear of others' opinion turn you from one good thing you know you must do this week.

sub: The hen that shields her young.
q: he will cover you with his pinions, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness is a shield and buckler.

Jerusalem, Jerusalem, the city that kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to it! How often have I desired to gather your children together as a hen gathers her brood under her wings, and you were not willing!
points.apply: Spend ten quiet minutes before the Blessed Sacrament, letting the Lord gather you.

concl: God rescues the godly, and his Son goes on to Jerusalem to spread his arms over us on the Cross.
His lament is the grief of love; our answer is to be willing to be gathered.
2027-03-16.resolve: Keep your conscience awake this week, and come under his wings in silent prayer.

intro: Theme: “For where two or three are gathered in my name, I am there among them.”
The old and new commandment of love, the Lord's way of reconciliation, and his presence among those gathered in his name.

q: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
Whoever loves a brother or sister lives in the light, and in such a person there is no cause for stumbling.
points.apply: Examine your heart for any resentment you have chosen to keep, and offer it to God today.

q: You shall not hate in your heart anyone of your kin; you shall reprove your neighbor, or you will incur guilt yourself.
If another member of the church sins against you, go and point out the fault when the two of you are alone. If the member listens to you, you have regained that one.
points.apply: Go privately and gently to one person with whom you have an unresolved quarrel.

points.h: Two or three in my name
q: How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
For where two or three are gathered in my name, I am there among them.
points.apply: Agree with a family member on one intention and pray for it together each night until Easter.

concl: Love is the old commandment made new in Christ; hatred keeps us in darkness however much we fast.
Go to your brother or sister, win them back, and pray together: Christ will be among you.
2027-03-17.resolve: Before Pesaha, take one step of reconciliation and begin one shared prayer.

intro: Theme: “Bear fruits worthy of repentance.”
Waterless springs that promise and do not give, and the Baptist's plain answer: share your coat and your bread.

sub: Training the heart the other way.
q: for my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the fountain of living water, and dug out cisterns for themselves, cracked cisterns that can hold no water.
These are waterless springs and mists driven by a storm; for them the deepest darkness has been reserved.
points.apply: Ask yourself honestly what a thirsty person would find in you today, and give it.

q: Wash yourselves; make yourselves clean; remove the evil of your doings from before my eyes; cease to do evil, learn to do good; seek justice, rescue the oppressed, defend the orphan, plead for the widow.
Bear fruits worthy of repentance. Do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our ancestor’; for I tell you, God is able from these stones to raise up children to Abraham.
points.apply: Thank God for the faith of your family, and add one fruit of your own to it this week.

q: Is it not to share your bread with the hungry, and bring the homeless poor into your house; when you see the naked, to cover them, and not to hide yourself from your own kin?
In reply he said to them, “Whoever has two coats must share with anyone who has none; and whoever has food must do likewise.”
points.apply: Give away clothes you do not wear, and share one meal with someone alone, before Pesaha.

concl: A Christian who promises and does not give is a waterless spring; the fast trains our hearts in generosity.
Our heritage is a gift; the fruit of repentance is a shared coat and a shared meal.
2027-03-18.resolve: Before Pesaha, empty one shelf for the poor and invite one lonely person to your table.

intro: Theme: “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
On the Fortieth Friday and the feast of St Joseph: Abraham's intercession remembered, a quarrel healed by speaking, Lazarus called from the tomb, and the just man who obeyed in the night.

q: So it was that, when God destroyed the cities of the Plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot had settled.
Therefore confess your sins to one another, and pray for one another, so that you may be healed. The prayer of the righteous is powerful and effective.
points.apply: Pray every day of the Week of the Passion for three people far from God, by name.

q: Have we not all one father? Has not one God created us? Why then are we faithless to one another, profaning the covenant of our ancestors?
Welcome one another, therefore, just as Christ has welcomed you, for the glory of God.
points.apply: Before you judge someone's actions this week, go and ask them what they meant.

sub: The loud voice of the Son.
Unbind him and let him go.
q: Therefore prophesy, and say to them, Thus says the Lord God: I am going to open your graves, and bring you up from your graves, O my people; and I will bring you back to the land of Israel.
The dead man came out, his hands and feet bound with strips of cloth, and his face wrapped in a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Unbind him, and let him go.”
points.apply: Make your Easter confession before Pesaha, and let the Lord unbind you.

points.h: Joseph did as the angel commanded
sub: A righteous man in the night.
q: do not fear, for I am with you, do not be afraid, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my victorious right hand.
When Joseph awoke from sleep, he did as the angel of the Lord commanded him; he took her as his wife,
points.apply: Do today, without delay or complaint, the one thing you know God is asking of you.

concl: The forty days are complete: God remembers our prayers, heals our quarrels and calls us out of our graves.
With St Joseph, let us enter the Week of the Passion obeying in silence and trusting that God is with us.
2027-03-19.resolve: Make the Way of the Cross today, go to confession before Pesaha, and share a meal with the poor in honour of the Holy Family.

intro: Theme: “The house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.”
Paul's farewell on the way to Jerusalem, and Mary's extravagant love on the eve of the Passion.

q: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his faithful ones.
But I do not count my life of any value to myself, if only I may finish my course and the ministry that I received from the Lord Jesus, to testify to the good news of God’s grace.
points.apply: Name the course God has given you to finish, and take one step on it this week.

sub: The flock obtained by his blood.
q: Since there will never cease to be some in need on the earth, I therefore command you, “Open your hand to the poor and needy neighbor in your land.”
In all this I have given you an example that by such work we must support the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus, for he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’
points.apply: Give one gift this week that costs you something.

sub: Kept for the day of his burial.
q: your anointing oils are fragrant, your name is perfume poured out; therefore the maidens love you.
Mary took a pound of costly perfume made of pure nard, anointed Jesus’ feet, and wiped them with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
points.apply: Prepare your home with your family for the Week of the Passion, and fill it with prayer.

concl: Paul and Mary both know that Jesus is going to his death, and both answer with love that does not calculate.
Tomorrow we cry Hosanna; this week let us pour out our best at his feet.
2027-03-20.resolve: Prepare the house for the Week of the Passion, and give one costly gift without counting.

intro: Theme: “and not for the nation only, but to gather into one the dispersed children of God.”
The beloved son sent to his brothers, an altar of witness, the eternal Son above the angels, and the one man who dies for the people.

q: And Israel said to Joseph, “Are not your brothers pasturing the flock at Shechem? Come, I will send you to them.” He answered, “Here I am.”
The patriarchs, jealous of Joseph, sold him into Egypt; but God was with him,
points.apply: Begin each morning of Hasha week by saying to the Father: Here I am.

q: How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
For he is our peace; in his flesh he has made both groups into one and has broken down the dividing wall, that is, the hostility between us.
points.apply: Go and listen to one person you have quarrelled with, before Pesaha evening.

sub: A prophecy deeper than Caiaphas knew.
q: But he was wounded for our transgressions, crushed for our iniquities; upon him was the punishment that made us whole, and by his bruises we are healed.

He did not say this on his own, but being high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus was about to die for the nation, and not for the nation only, but to gather into one the dispersed children of God.
points.apply: Pray this week for someone who has drifted away from the Church, and invite them to the Pesaha Qurbana.

concl: The Father sends his beloved Son to look for his brothers and sisters, and the Son goes willingly to die for the people.
Let us stop quarrelling, gather at one altar, and let him gather us into one.
2027-03-22.resolve: Heal one quarrel and invite one scattered person home before Pesaha.

intro: Theme: “Very truly, I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains just a single grain; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.”
Joseph stripped and sold, the high priest who prayed with tears, and the grain of wheat that dies to bear fruit.

q: When some Midianite traders passed by, they drew Joseph up, lifting him out of the pit, and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. And they took Joseph to Egypt.
For the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many.
points.apply: Name one jealousy in your heart and pray today for the good of the person you envy.

sub: A high priest from among us.
Prayers in the days of his flesh.
q: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, from the words of my groaning?
In the days of his flesh, Jesus offered up prayers and supplications, with loud cries and tears, to the one who was able to save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverent submission.
points.apply: Bring one sorrow you have carried alone to God in prayer tonight, and pray for your priests.

q: And now do not be distressed, or angry with yourselves, because you sold me here; for God sent me before you to preserve life.
Very truly, I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains just a single grain; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.
points.apply: Give up one comfort today for someone else's good, and offer it with the grain of wheat.

concl: What the brothers meant for evil, God turned to good; what looked like defeat on the Cross became the harvest of the world.
Let us not keep our lives in the granary, but fall into the earth with Christ and bear fruit.
2027-03-23.resolve: Uproot one jealousy, pray for one priest, and give up one comfort for another's good this week.

intro: Theme: “And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
The forgotten prisoner and the Lord who remembers, Joshua's farewell, the blood of the new covenant offered once for all, and the Son of Man lifted up.

sub: A cup, bread and three days.
q: But remember me when it is well with you; please do me the kindness to make mention of me to Pharaoh, and so get me out of this place.
Then he said, “Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom.”
points.apply: Thank one person you have forgotten, and ask the Lord to remember you in his kingdom.

q: Moses took the blood and dashed it on the people, and said, “See the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
But as it is, he has appeared once for all at the end of the age to remove sin by the sacrifice of himself.
points.apply: Make a good confession before Pesaha, so that you may share worthily in the one sacrifice.

q: See, my servant shall prosper; he shall be exalted and lifted up, and shall be very high.
And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.
points.apply: Spend five quiet minutes tonight before a crucifix and let the Lord draw you.

concl: We forget, but the Lord remembers; we fail, but his one sacrifice stands for ever.
Lifted up on the Cross, he draws all people to himself; tomorrow he will give himself into our hands.
2027-03-24.resolve: Prepare the Pesaha table, make your confession, and thank one forgotten benefactor.

intro: Theme: “In a little while the world will no longer see me, but you will see me; because I live, you also will live.”
The light that never sets, the witness of the empty tomb, faith reckoned as righteousness, and the peace of the Risen Lord.

points.h: Your days of mourning are ended
q: Your sun shall no more go down, or your moon withdraw itself; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your days of mourning shall be ended.
And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, for the glory of God is its light, and its lamp is the Lamb.
points.apply: Name one sorrow and bring it to the Risen Lord in prayer today.

sub: The Holy One does not see corruption.
q: For you do not give me up to Sheol, or let your faithful one see the Pit.
This Jesus God raised up, and of that all of us are witnesses.
points.apply: Tell one person this week what the Resurrection means to you.

q: And he believed the LORD; and the LORD reckoned it to him as righteousness.
Blessed are those whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered;
points.apply: Make an Easter confession this week and thank God for his mercy.

sub: The Father and the Son make their home.
Peace not as the world gives.
q: Father of orphans and protector of widows is God in his holy habitation.
Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled, and do not let them be afraid.
points.apply: Pass the peace of the Lord at home every evening this week.

concl: The Risen Christ is our everlasting light, our righteousness and our peace.
Because he lives, we live: let us live like it this week.
2027-03-29.resolve: This week, make an Easter confession, pray to the Holy Spirit before reading Scripture, and say ‘The peace of the Lord be with you’ at home each evening.

intro: Theme: “Then beginning with Moses and all the prophets, he interpreted to them the things about himself in all the scriptures.”
The Anointed One who frees captives, the four pillars of the first Church, the faith that rests on the Resurrection, and the road to Emmaus.

sub: The Spirit of the Lord upon him.
Liberty to the captives of death.
q: The spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me, because the LORD has anointed me; he has sent me to bring good news to the oppressed, to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and release to the prisoners;
Then he began to say to them, “Today this scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”
points.apply: Repair one broken relationship this Easter week.

q: A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove from your body the heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and fellowship, to the breaking of bread and the prayers.
points.apply: Strengthen the weakest of the four pillars in your family this week.

points.h: If Christ has not been raised
sub: The first fruits of the dead.
q: He will swallow up death forever. Then the Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from all faces,
If Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile and you are still in your sins.
points.apply: Say the article of the Creed slowly today: ‘I believe in the resurrection of the body.’

sub: Known in the breaking of bread.
q: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
They said to each other, “Were not our hearts burning within us while he was talking to us on the road, while he was opening the scriptures to us?”
points.apply: Walk with someone who is sad this week, and come to the Qurbana ready to recognise the Lord.

concl: The Risen Christ walks with the disappointed, opens the Scriptures and makes himself known in the breaking of bread.
Let our hearts burn with his Word, and let our feet run to tell the others.
2027-03-30.resolve: This week, read Isaiah 53 or Psalm 22 with Jesus, repair one broken relationship, and walk with someone who is sad.

intro: Theme: “I am the vine, you are the branches. Those who abide in me and I in them bear much fruit, because apart from me you can do nothing.”
The bride clothed with salvation, the Church praying for boldness, the unity of the Spirit, and the true vine.

q: For as a young man marries a young woman, so shall your builder marry you, and as the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your God rejoice over you.
As many of you as were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.
points.apply: Thank God today for your Baptism, and believe that he delights in you.

q: Why do the nations conspire, and the peoples plot in vain?
When they had prayed, the place in which they were gathered together was shaken; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God with boldness.
points.apply: Speak a word of faith this week where you would usually keep silent.

points.h: One Lord, one faith, one baptism
sub: A life worthy of the calling.
Bearing with one another in love.
q: How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to the one hope of your calling, one Lord, one faith, one baptism, one God and Father of all, who is above all and through all and in all.
points.apply: Bear patiently with one difficult person this week.

q: You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.
As the Father has loved me, so I have loved you; abide in my love.
points.apply: Spend ten minutes before the Blessed Sacrament this week, simply abiding.

concl: The Risen Christ is the Bridegroom who delights in us and the vine who gives us life.
Abide in him, pray for boldness, keep the unity of the Spirit, and you will bear much fruit.
2027-03-31.resolve: This week, abide ten minutes daily with Christ, speak one word of faith with courage, and bear lovingly with one difficult person.
